page.layout: One printed page with a single text column; running head at top centre-right with page number at left; right margin holds faint show-through and partial notes from the facing page, not transcribed.

main_text.p: quadratis, Genius noster mangonizatum vadit singula: & Cæli quidem Physicè simplices, id est, Materiæ primæ & Formæ substantialis expertes ponuntur: Spectat enim ad Mundi ornatum & complementum, ut corpus tale aliquod complexu suo teneat: mutila videri posset, si hoc Gradu entis destitueretur Rerum Universitas: Ex simili delirio, corpora cælestia non generantur, non corrumpuntur, non crescunt, non decrescunt, non gravia sunt, non levia. Post hæc, potestatibus miris donantur sidera, influentiis & qualitatibus, à nomine, occultis: à re tam

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page at the right margin is ignored. Line "quadratis, Genius noster" begins a fragment continuing from the previous page; the paragraph is treated as beginning at the top of the column. The word "tam" at the end is a catchword-like continuation and is kept in the text.
